components.css: .ds-box { position: relative; display: block; width: 120px; height: 120px; background: var(--card, #f7f7f9); border: 1px solid var(--line, #c6c6d0); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--blue, #0000ff); text-decoration: none; font-family: Archivo, 'Noto Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; transition: width .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), height .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), border-color .2s, box-shadow .3s; } .ds-front, .ds-back { position: absolute; inset: 0; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-front { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-front svg { width: 44%; } .ds-front b { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #0b0b1c); } .ds-front i { font-size: 8px; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6a6a7a); } .ds-back { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 14px; opacity: 0; color: var(--ink, #0b0b1c); } .ds-back b { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-back i { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue, #0000ff); } .ds-back span { font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted, #6a6a7a); } .ds-back em { margin-top: auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-style: normal; color: var(--blue, #0000ff); } .ds-box:hover, .ds-box:focus-visible { width: 168px; height: 168px; border-color: var(--blue, #0000ff); box-shadow: 0 22px 44px -22px rgba(0,0,120,.45); } .ds-box:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #0000ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-box:hover .ds-front, .ds-box:focus-visible .ds-front { opacity: 0; } .ds-box:hover .ds-back, .ds-box:focus-visible .ds-back { opacity: 1; transition-delay: .12s; }

narrative.overview:
The home is one screen: the blue chair logo at the centre of a hairline ring, with the eight rooms orbiting it as small pale cards. Hovering a card grows and turns it over to show the room's detail; clicking grows it into the room itself. On the category page that card becomes a full-bleed photo hero (View Transition room-hero), and the product list below reuses the same card: pale fill, hairline border, 6px corners, blue on hover.

The world is quiet, grey and exact. It uses one saturated colour, the logo blue (#0000FF). Everything else is a narrow set of cool greys: a grey page, a lighter card, a hairline and near-black ink. Depth comes from the hairline border and a single soft, blue-tinted lift that appears only on hover or focus. Photography brings the only warm colour, and only in the category hero and the product pictures.

Every piece of copy pairs Thai with English. Thai carries the meaning at full size, and English sits beside or below it as a small, wide, tracked uppercase line.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, the logo blue, used for state, prices, sale badges and the contact band.
Pale cards (#F7F7F9) on grey (#EBEBEB), outlined with a 1px hairline and 6px corners.
Archivo + Noto Sans Thai in one stack. English appears as a tracked uppercase echo of the Thai.
Surfaces are flat at rest. They lift only in response to hover or focus.
Motion settles and grows: cards expand, heroes morph, lines draw.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Logo Blue is the only chromatic colour the interface itself uses. A new state, tag or highlight uses blue or a grey, never a new hue.

rules.name: The Photo Scrim Rule
rules.body: White type sits on photos only over an ink scrim: a radial pool behind the title plus a linear top-and-bottom darkening, with a soft ink text-shadow on the display line. Gradients in this world are scrims, not decoration.

rules.name: The Thai-First Rule
rules.body: Thai comes first and takes the larger size. English follows at label or echo scale. Never show English alone where Thai belongs.

rules.name: The Wide-English Rule
rules.body: Tracking and 125% width belong to Latin uppercase only. Thai lines always reset to letter-spacing: 0 and normal case.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Intent Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. The blue lift is a reply to the pointer or focus, always paired with a Logo Blue border.

dos: Do build every new surface from the six tokens in app/src/styles/tokens.css: ground, card, hairline, ink, muted and Logo Blue.
Do put content on pale cards with a 1px hairline and 6px corners. On hover or focus, answer with a blue border, the blue lift (0 22px 44px -22px rgba(0,0,120,.45)) and a 2px rise.
Do pair every Thai heading with an English line at label or echo scale, and reset tracking to 0 on Thai.
Do use the Arrow and RoomIcon SVG components for every directional or room cue, stroked in currentColor.
Do keep white type on photos over the ink scrim, and give a photo credit its own local scrim.
Do use --ease (cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)) for growth and state, and --ease-out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) for entrances. Honour prefers-reduced-motion everywhere.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue. Sale, active and link states all use Logo Blue.
Don't cast a shadow at rest, and don't use hard or offset shadows.
Don't track or widen Thai text, or set it in uppercase styling.
Don't use text glyphs (↗, →) as icons. Use the Arrow component.
Don't round containers beyond 6px. Pills are for chips only, and circles are for the ring and the scroll cue only.
